mapper.select: /* PdaCargoReceiveMapper.selectExistMasterScan : 입항화물도착 MBL 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 MBL_NO , AR_DATE , AR_TIME , CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , BL_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE MBL_NO = #{srchNo}

/* PdaCargoReceiveMapper.selectMasterDest : 입항화물도착 Master Dest 조회 */ DECLARE @srchCnt INT = #{listSize}; SELECT TOP (@srchCnt) SEQ AS seq , MBL_NO AS mblNo , PIECES AS pieces , AR_DATE AS arDate , AR_TIME AS arTime , FORMAT(CAST(CONCAT(AR_DATE, ' ', AR_TIME) AS DATETIME), 'yy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS arDateTime , DEST_DATE AS destDate , DEST_TIME AS destTime , FORMAT(CAST(CONCAT(DEST_DATE, ' ', DEST_TIME) AS DATETIME), 'yy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS destDateTime , REGISTER_USER_ID AS registerUserId , REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS registerDateTime , UPDATE_USER_ID AS updateUserId , UPDATE_DATE_TIME AS updateDateTime FROM TB_BMS_MASTER_DEST WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY UPDATE_DATE_TIME DESC

/* PdaCargoReceiveMapper.selectMasterDestList : 입항화물도착 Master Dest 조회 */ SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT SEQ AS seq , MBL_NO AS mblNo , PIECES AS pieces , AR_DATE AS arDate , AR_TIME AS arTime , FORMAT(CAST(CONCAT(AR_DATE, ' ', AR_TIME) AS DATETIME), 'yy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS arDateTime , DEST_DATE AS destDate , DEST_TIME AS destTime , FORMAT(CAST(CONCAT(DEST_DATE, ' ', DEST_TIME) AS DATETIME), 'yy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS destDateTime , REGISTER_USER_ID AS registerUserId , REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS registerDateTime , UPDATE_USER_ID AS updateUserId , UPDATE_DATE_TIME AS updateDateTime , SUM(IIF(DEST_DATE = '', 0, 1)) OVER(PARTITION BY MBL_NO) AS DEST_CNT FROM TB_BMS_MASTER_DEST WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE MBL_NO = #{mblNo} ) T WHERE 1=1 AND ((DEST_CNT > 0 AND destDate != '') OR DEST_CNT = 0 ) ORDER BY T.destDate DESC, T.destTime DESC, T.SEQ DESC

/* PdaCargoReceiveMapper.selectMasterDestList_bak : 입항화물도착 Master Dest 조회 */ SELECT SEQ AS seq , MBL_NO AS mblNo , PIECES AS pieces , AR_DATE AS arDate , AR_TIME AS arTime , FORMAT(CAST(CONCAT(AR_DATE, ' ', AR_TIME) AS DATETIME), 'yy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS arDateTime , DEST_DATE AS destDate , DEST_TIME AS destTime , FORMAT(CAST(CONCAT(DEST_DATE, ' ', DEST_TIME) AS DATETIME), 'yy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS destDateTime , REGISTER_USER_ID AS registerUserId , REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS registerDateTime , UPDATE_USER_ID AS updateUserId , UPDATE_DATE_TIME AS updateDateTime FROM TB_BMS_MASTER_DEST WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE MBL_NO = #{mblNo} ORDER BY DEST_DATE DESC, DEST_TIME DESC
mapper.delete: /* PdaCargoReceiveMapper.updateMasterDest */ DELETE FROM TB_BMS_MASTER_DEST WHERE SEQ = #{seq}
